text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio brought immense excitement to 
the Japanese Derby.

However, she couldn't help but feel 
frustrated that she was unable to flash 
the peace sign to signify conquering two 
of the Triple Crown legs.

However, Tokai Teio's challenge is not 
over yet.

To claim victory in the Kikuka Sho, the 
final remaining Classic race, her 
challenge continues...!
